in_marathi.name: Iraansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iraansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Iraansh is derived from the Sanskrit language, a combination of two words - Ira (Lord Vishnu) and Ansh (grace or presence). This name symbolizes the divine blessings and protection of Lord Vishnu, who is revered for maintaining the balance and harmony in the universe.
